# Automation Scripts for Discovered Patterns

## Pattern: Dependency Updates
```bash
# Example: Automated dependency update commit
#!/bin/bash
PACKAGE_NAME="$1"
OLD_VERSION="$2"
NEW_VERSION="$3"

git add .
git commit -m "Bump ${PACKAGE_NAME} from ${OLD_VERSION} to ${NEW_VERSION}"
```

## Pattern: Documentation Updates
```bash
# Example: Automated documentation update commit
#!/bin/bash
DOC_FILE="$1"

git add "${DOC_FILE}"
git commit -m "Update ${DOC_FILE}"
```

## Regex Patterns for Matching

### Dependency Update Pattern
```regex
(update|bump|upgrade)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9._-]+)\s+(from|to)\s+(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)
```

### Documentation Update Pattern
```regex
(update|add|fix)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9._-]+\.(md|txt))
```

### Conventional Commit Pattern
```regex
^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)(\([a-z]+\))?:
```
